newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 per tonne lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 per tonne lower.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $5 lower Tuesday on the heels of a weak performance in London overnight, traders said.
LIFFE cocoa futures were lower in light trading, with July down 11 stg at the midday break at 1,015 stg a tonne and September 10 stg lower at 1,034 stg.

Monday, New York cocoa futures stumbled in light trade, pressured by speculative liquidation. July finished down $20 at $1,449 a tonne after ranging from $1,467 to $1,445. Second-month September ended $16 lower at $1,485, while the back months slumped $13 to $16.

Technically, July key support was pegged at $1,444, with the next downside target at $1,425. Near-term resistance was seen near $1,460, then Monday's high of $1,467. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodity Desk 212 859 1640))
